# Fast PR checks for pkgs/id — the canonical list built by id-check.yml.
#
# One check name per line (a checks.x86_64-linux attribute of
# pkgs/id/flake.nix). check-id-pr-checks.sh guards this list against the
# flake: a flake check that is neither listed here nor excluded there
# fails the PR gate by name, as does a listed name the flake no longer
# defines.
#
# Intentionally NOT listed (see check-id-pr-checks.sh for the single
# exclusion list): the `default` aggregate, which re-runs this same set
# inside a single derivation, and the heavy checks that run nightly in
# id-e2e-nightly.yml (test-e2e and the nixos-* VM checks). Also not
# listed: the aggregate test recipes `test`, `test-web` and `test-int`
# — the test-shard-* checks below plus test-unit, test-web-unit and
# test-web-typecheck cover every test they run, in parallel (#869).
# Also not listed: the aggregate `crash-gate` — the crash-gate-*
# checks below partition its tests by name filter in parallel (#551).
cargo-fmt-check
rustfmt-check
web-fmt-check
prettier-check
nix-fmt-check
treefmt-check
biome-check
shellcheck-check
shfmt-check
statix-check
taplo-check
clippy-lint
web-lint
cargo-check
test-unit
test-shard-0
test-shard-1
test-shard-2
test-shard-3
test-web-unit
test-web-typecheck
crash-gate-sampled
crash-gate-sweep
crash-gate-control
